true_answer: Here is another way to write the same set. A | { x ∈ N : x is even } . Note: Sometimes mathematicians use | or ϶ for the “such that” symbol instead of the colon. Also, there is a fairly even split between mathemati- cians about whether 0 is an element of the natural numbers, so be careful there. This notation is usually called set builder notation . It tells use how to build a set by telling us precisely the condition elements must meet to gain access (the condition is the logical statement after the “ : ” symbol). Reading and comprehending sets written in this way takes practice.
